title: Public Symbolic CAS Probes
description: Externally sourced symbolic identities and near-miss refutations that require the symbolic CAS route. These are expected to run in the Docker verifier image when host CAS tools are unavailable.

tasks.aiFailureMode: States a standard symbolic identity without a replayable CAS trace or independent cross-check.
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the single-variable sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2 equality against an explicit numeric constant is compiled. Cross-checked CAS evidence is not a proof-checker-backed theorem.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a near-miss right-hand side for a famous identity because the statement looks familiar.
requiredEvidence: CAS result mismatch against the stated right-hand side
independent Maxima agreement with the computed left-hand side
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated numeric right-hand-side mismatch is refuted inside the symbolic compiler boundary. This does not prove arbitrary trigonometric theorems.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Expands a familiar binomial pattern without a replayable symbolic residual check or independent CAS agreement.
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the one-variable polynomial identity residual is compiled. Cross-checked CAS evidence is not a proof-checker-backed theorem.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a near-miss binomial expansion with the wrong constant term because the pattern looks familiar.
requiredEvidence: nonzero residual for the stated equality
independent Maxima agreement with the residual
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated one-variable polynomial residual mismatch is refuted. This does not prove arbitrary binomial theorem instances.
